title: Add stale-finding SLA to JOB-SEC-001 to prevent findings ageing without disposition
summary: JOB-SEC-001 is detecting but not closing recurring issues. SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 are 9+ days open with no disposition.
body: Jobs Review (2026-03-16) found JOB-SEC-001 generates findings without closing them. SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 (trust_model.multi_user_heuristic) and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02 (non-elevated PF posture) both 9+ days open. Required: (1) define stale-finding SLA (e.g. 7 days to disposition); (2) add SLA enforcement to JOB-SEC-001 definition; (3) apply retroactively — disposition SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02.
expected_closure_evidence: JOB-SEC-001 definition updated with explicit stale-finding SLA and enforcement rule
evidence or decision records showing retroactive disposition of SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02
validation artifact confirming the stale-finding rule is now part of the recurring security review loop
requested_action: Define and enforce stale-finding SLA in JOB-SEC-001; formally disposition SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02.
proposed_action: Define and enforce stale-finding SLA in JOB-SEC-001; formally disposition SEC-AUTO-20260307-01 and SEC-AUTO-20260309-02.
